agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/sql.py: Token.is_child_of(self, other) incorrectly used `self.parent != other` instead of `self.parent == other`, inverting its documented behavior. Corrected to `return self.parent == other`. Verified via manual script that a token correctly reports is_child_of(its real parent) == True and is_child_of(None) == False.
